"""只读绑定31381后台数据，使用本地逐题checker复判六个自产程序。"""
import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT));sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import judge
import audit_gmyhf_course_spj as audit
common=audit.common
sha=lambda raw:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
checker=ROOT/'data/openjudge/tests/30000-/31381_made/checker.py'
evidence=ROOT/'collab/gmyhf-course-spj-recheck.json';prior=json.loads(evidence.read_text())
session=common.platform.oj_submit.Session().login()
url=common.platform.oj_submit.HOST+'/admin/problems/edit/?id=31381'
before=session._get(url)
assert common.form_sha(before)==prior['form_sha256']
assert common.listed_files(before,31381)==sorted(prior['readback_files'])
payloads={name:common.platform.download(session,31381,name) for name in prior['readback_files']}
assert {name:sha(raw) for name,raw in payloads.items()}==prior['readback_files']
results=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cs101-31381-spj-') as temp:
    mirror=Path(temp);directory=mirror/'tests/31381_made';directory.mkdir(parents=True)
    shutil.copyfile(checker,directory/'checker.py')
    for name,raw in payloads.items():(directory/name).write_bytes(raw)
    item={'book':'t31381','id':'31381','checker':'tests/31381_made/checker.py','test_cases':[{'input':'tests/31381_made/0.in','output':'tests/31381_made/0.out'}]}
    with patch.object(judge,'MIRROR',mirror),patch.object(judge,'catalog_item',return_value=item):
        for name,source in audit.probe_sources().items():
            wanted='Wrong Answer' if name.endswith('_invalid') else 'Accepted'
            result=judge.judge('t31381','31381','python',source)
            assert result['status']==wanted,(name,result)
            results.append({'probe':name,'source':source,'source_sha256':sha(source.encode()),'expected':wanted,'observed':result})
            print(name,result['status'],flush=True)
after=session._get(url)
assert common.form_sha(after)==common.form_sha(before)
assert common.listed_files(after,31381)==sorted(payloads)
for name,raw in payloads.items():assert sha(common.platform.download(session,31381,name))==sha(raw)
source=Path(__file__).read_text()
report={'scope':'31381本地逐题SPJ实现；原后台一组数据只读绑定、六个自产程序走既有判题沙箱。未替换OpenJudge远端SPJ，未新增题库映射。','checked_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'checker_path':str(checker.relative_to(ROOT)),'checker_sha256':sha(checker.read_bytes()),'test_path':'tests/test_31381_checker.py','test_sha256':sha((ROOT/'tests/test_31381_checker.py').read_bytes()),'prior_platform_evidence':str(evidence.relative_to(ROOT)),'prior_platform_evidence_sha256':sha(evidence.read_bytes()),'readback_files':{name:sha(raw) for name,raw in payloads.items()},'form_sha256':common.form_sha(before),'local_judge_results':results,'local_accepted':3,'local_wrong_answer':3,'test_data_writes':0,'statement_writes':0,'configuration_writes':0,'submission_writes':0,'catalog_changed':False,'remote_spj_replaced':False,'mutation_evidence':'collab/gmyhf-31381-spj-mutations.json','mutation_evidence_sha256':sha((ROOT/'collab/gmyhf-31381-spj-mutations.json').read_bytes()),'procedure_source':source,'procedure_sha256':sha(source.encode())}
common.save(ROOT/'collab/gmyhf-31381-spj-implementation.json',report)
print('后台两文件前后哈希一致，本地六探针结果正确，平台零写入',flush=True)
